title: The Client Report Error
brief: A client of Meridian Advisory writes that report {{rep}} contains a wrong interest rate assumption, which changed their board decision paper. They want a written response in 3 working days. You have 12 visit points to contain, find the cause, and respond.

actions.label: Other reports using the same assumption
General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: Complaint CC-44 logged the same day with an owner.
3 other reports this month (R-1838, R-1839, R-1841) used the same assumption; none reviewed or clients informed.
evidence.missedExplanation: Check other reports with the same input.

evidence.text: Assumption came from an analyst's personal spreadsheet, not the assumptions register (file AS-tmp-04).
evidence.whyItMatters: Controlled data sources must be used.
evidence.missedExplanation: Trace where the assumption came from.

evidence.text: Peer review record for {{rep}} is dated after the report was sent.
evidence.whyItMatters: Review must happen before release or with authorization.

evidence.text: Assumptions register AR-1 holds the correct rate.
Partner: "We were late, so I sent it and asked for review after." (note 2)
evidence.whyItMatters: Leaders must support the review step.

evidence.text: Complaint procedure requires a response in 3 working days.
Notification steps for insurers exist but have not been considered for this case (procedure PI-1).
Report formatting is consistent with the template.
The analyst who built AS-tmp joined 2 months ago; induction record IN-7 does not cover the assumptions register.

options: A corrected report with the reviewed figures, what went wrong, the check of other reports, actions with dates, and a contact
A statement that assumptions are the client's risk
A request to ignore the figure
decisions.rationale: The client needs a corrected report and confidence that the cause is addressed.

containment: Review the 3 other reports and inform those clients
correction: Issue corrected report {{rep}} after peer review
cause: Uncontrolled personal spreadsheets were used and reports could be sent before review
corrective: Require register sources and block sending before review is recorded
effectiveness: Audit send and review dates monthly for three months

debriefText.found: You contained other reports and traced the source.
debriefText.missed: Compare review dates with send dates.
debriefText.falseFinding: Formatting and desks are not findings.
